# SB-1030 Safety bulletin: quench oil fire risk
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Hazard description
A latent failure mode has been identified in the radial ring rolling quench system on EQ-P2-L1-RR01 that can lead to a quench oil ignition event. Oil containment and return paths can be compromised by a loose mandrel clamp bolt, resulting in oil spray onto hot surfaces and bearings. Ignition sources in the immediate area and insufficient local oil containment increase the likelihood of a fire that can propagate along the roll train and adjacent equipment. Operators have reported oil misting during upset conditions consistent with clamp retention loss. This bulletin summarizes the immediate controls required to mitigate the identified fire risk and prevent recurrence.

Affected equipment
- Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1: EQ-P2-L1-RR01 (located on line P2-L1, Plant P2)  
- Associated quench oil lines and local splash guards connected to EQ-P2-L1-RR01  
Refer to maintenance history and control drawings in MM-P2-L1-RR01-S2 for the affected assemblies.

Required controls
- Verify and document the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. Adjust only with calibrated tooling and record results in the maintenance log referenced in MM-P2-L1-RR01-S2.  
- Install or confirm presence of functional splash guards and drip trays on EQ-P2-L1-RR01 to capture any leaked or sprayed oil; maintain as per SOP-P2-L1-04.  
- Update pre-start checklist to include a visual inspection of clamp retention and quench return integrity before hot operations, and follow SOP-P2-L1-05 for abnormal oil leakage response.  
- Isolate ignition sources within the work envelope during any maintenance that exposes oil lines; use controls described in SOP-P2-L1-05.  
- Communicate this bulletin to operations, maintenance, and supervision; retain verification records on file with the site safety lead.

Effective date
Effective date: Immediate

Related documents
MM-P2-L1-RR01-S2, SOP-P2-L1-04, SOP-P2-L1-05
